reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was that there are zero reviews, and I don't buy anything I take every night without hundreds of them. The lab QR on the box is a nice touch, but I already have a magnesium that works for me and I'm not going to be the guinea pig.
objection: No reviews at all, so I can't check the 1-star complaints about stomach trouble, capsule size or whether the dose is real. A QR code is the brand's own claim, not other people's experience.
